findings: the gates are multi-entry state machines: the prologue dispatches on byte [rbx+0x71] through the relative table at 0x60bb44 in gate_c (0x6041ec in gate_a), exactly five arms, and three more dispatches live inside - byte [rbx+0xd0] (table 0x60bb58, 9 arms), byte [rbx+0xad0] (table 0x60bb7c, 32 arms in gate_c against 28 at 0x604224 in gate_a) and byte [rbx+0x120] (table 0x60bbfc, 5 arms).  Every exit writes the next outer state back to +0x71 (3 or 4 on the checker exits, 4 on the wide-phase exit, 1 on the return-0 exit, 2 on the unwind path), so one call advances the machine and the caller re-invokes it

the late pair loads are the unwind path's free, not a second consumption: gate_c loads [rbx+0x78] at 0x2cbb0ba and [rbx+0x80] at 0x2cbb0c3 exactly once more, inside a landing-pad block, guarded by flag byte [rbx+0x74] != 0 and length > 0, and calls the dealloc slot 0x64df4a0 on (pointer, length).  The flag is set on the normal path at 0x2cb6bc7 (word [rbx+0x73] = 0x100) immediately before the pair is (re)built at +0x78 and cleared after the free; gate_a mirrors the free at 0x2aefb11/0x2aefb29 with a sentinel-and-zero test in place of the signed test.  The full rbx census shows these are the only loads of +0x78/+0x80 besides the lookup arguments at 0x2cb68f6/0x2cb68fa

the +0x90 address-takes set up the +0xd0 sub-machine: at entry state 4 (0x2cb6b40) and again inside its state-0 arm (0x2cb715f) the gate loads the state byte [rbx+0xd0], takes r15 = &[rbx+0xd0] and r13 = &[rbx+0x90] and dispatches through the +0xd0 table; the arms process the +0x90 sub-object through r13 - a direct call 0x26e11f0 (rsi = r15, rdx = r13, r8 = 1) at 0x2cb6ac0, an insert through slot 0x64e0ec0 into &[rbx+0xc0] at 0x2cb6adf, and an element free loop - while the state-3 arm (0x2cb6b65) instead spills &[rbx+0xad0] to [rsp+0x50] and &[rbx+0xd8] to [rsp+0x78] and dispatches the 32-state +0xad0 machine

after the key lookup the gate dispatches on the outcome byte [rbx+0x11c]: the == 2 arm (tag nonzero) and every != 1 arm land at 0x2cb6ba0, which writes outcome 1 to the record byte at +0x120 - through the &[rbx+0x120] pointer both merge paths spill to [rsp+0x18] (0x2cb67b8, 0x2cb67e4) - destroys the +0xad0 sub-object (direct call 0x2c901a0 at 0x2cb6bad), sets the +0x74 ownership flag and rebuilds the +0x78 pair from the +0x48 triple (movdqu [rbx+0x48] -> [rbx+0x78] at 0x2cb6bd6, [rbx+0x88] = [rbx+0x58] at 0x2cb6bdf).  The == 1 arm instead allocates a 0x30-byte refcounted block (alloc slot 0x64df480 at 0x2cb6939), stores it at [rbx+0xa0], calls builder 0x2d47710 on a stack descriptor (0x2cb69b2) and writes the double bits 0x403e000000000000 (30.0) at [rbx+0xa8] with [rbx+0xb0..+0xc0] zeroed

the returned byte is decided by an exit funnel over the single ret (gate_c 0x2cbb7e8): (i) the +0x120 state-4 arm enters at 0x2cbb708 and calls checker 0x2c7f360 on &[rbx+0x150] with the saved context pointer as rsi; nonzero writes outcome 4 to +0x120, sets +0x71 = 3 and returns 1, while zero continues through the [rbx+0x1e0]/[rbx+0x1d8] tag checks, the +0x168/+0x170 refcount drop, destructor 0x2ca0790 on &[rbx+0x178], the +0x138 pair free and the +0xd8 pair free into the global-state phase at 0x2cbb0e6; a second flow reaches the same call after copying [rbx+0x130] to [rbx+0x150] and zeroing [rbx+0x1e0] (0x2cbb6f1).  (ii) the +0x120 state-3 arm calls checker 0x2c7fa40 on &[rbx+0x128] (0x2cbb481) with the context pointer; bit 0 set writes outcome 3 to +0x120, +0x71 = 3, returns 1

the remaining funnel entries: (iii) a wide phase (record fields up to +0x2a1f, stack copies of 0x138 and 0x7f0 bytes) exits when its r12 == 2, writing byte 4 through the [rsp+0x50] spill and byte 3 through the [rsp+0x20] spill, setting +0x71 = 4 and returning 1 (0x2cb801d-0x2cb8034); the r14 checker phase's nonzero arm enters the same tail mid-way at 0x2cb802d (byte 4 through the [rsp+0x20] spill it just loaded, after writing byte 3 through its own r15 at 0x2cb992c).  (iv) the return-0 exit is that same phase's zero arm: after the +0xf8/+0x100 group is dropped (0x2ca0790 on &[rbx+0x100], call 0x2ca3ab0) it writes byte 1 through r15 (0x2cb998a), sets [rbx+0xd0] = 1, clears the word at +0x73, sets +0x71 = 1 and returns 0 (0x2cb99a7) - the only zero return in the body; the shaper then drops the record

precise negative: which record bytes the [rsp+0x50] and [rsp+0x20] spills name on funnel entries (iii) is not statically decidable from the gate body - both slots are redefined with unrelated values in other phases ([rsp+0x50] holds &[rbx+0x78] at 0x2cb67d6 and 0x2cb67f4 and stack-copy addresses in the wide phase; [rsp+0x20] holds r15 saves at 0x2cb7014/0x2cb746f and an xmm spill at 0x2cb6c02).  The values written (4 and 3), the guards, the +0x71 writes and the return bytes are pinned; the two store targets are not.  The unwind pad's byte-2 store through [rsp+0x20] at 0x2cbb07f has the same boundary

the unwind path writes outcome 2 and +0x71 = 2: the landing pads set the +0xad0 state byte ([rbx+0xad0] = 2 at 0x2cbb069), free the +0x118/+0x120 pair, destroy the +0xd8 object (0x2ca1ca0) and the +0x120 object (0x2ca14a0 at 0x2cbb087), free the manufactured pair under its +0x74 flag, and the shared tail at 0x2cbbba8 frees the +0x48 pair under its +0x73 flag, writes byte 2 to +0x120 (0x2cbbb9b), sets +0x71 = 2 (0x2cbbbc7) and resumes the unwind (_Unwind_Resume at 0x2cbbbce) - it never reaches the ret

the global-state phase at 0x2cbb0e6 (entered from 0x2cb707a, 0x2cbb7a9 and 0x2cbb7be) is the same lazy-init machinery as the early phase: it loads the global through slot 0x64e0918, tests [global+0x50], and on the unset arm completes the initialisation through slot 0x64df9f0 with the .data.rel.ro descriptor statics at 0x644da18/0x644da30 as arguments.  The post-check phases also contain date/time conversion blocks whose failure paths reference the .rodata messages at 0x465ab7 and 0x4676bb

gate_a mirrors the funnel with the same values: its epilogue (0x2af0229-0x2af024e) is entered from 0x2aefefd (checker 0x2a91280, bit-0 test, outcome 3), 0x2af0184 (checker 0x2a90a50, zero test, outcome 4), 0x2aeca14 (wide-phase entry, +0x71 = 4) and 0x2aee477 (return 0, +0x71 = 1).  The clones swap two spill slots: gate_a's &[rbx+0x120] spill lives at [rsp+0x20] and its context pointer at [rsp+0x18], where gate_c uses the reverse assignment
